A '''battle''' of the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], was fought in [[3996 BBY]]. At the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab system]], the two sides fought with the Sith emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was referenced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It illustrated the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.
